test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing ‘1'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23b4f9b00c4a35ec8e96eb79b386cee2593f3cdbbc83d91030764b7193efa2aa.png]
solution:
As 4 and 5 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41bbdc09b0891e3990b50160d9918f6065c8e8200864460396e8585b4bc7a383.png] 

Therefore, '3' is the number on the face opposite the face showing '1'.

Hence, ‘**3**’ is the correct answer.
